comment: Token unlock watchlist. Two entry types: 'monthlyDay' = recurring cliff on that day each month (most vesting contracts release monthly); 'date' = one-off YYYY-MM-DD. Bot pings 7 days and 3 days before. verified:true = confirmed against cryptorank.io/token-unlock on 2026-08-01; others are recurring-schedule estimates — check the date on cryptorank before acting.

tokens.name: EigenCloud

events.detail: detect-cadence.js: 11 consecutive MONTH-END distributions Sep 2025-Jul 2026 from custody 0x34BcF805A5..., mean 7.82M EIGEN/mo, cv low; second metronome 0x3De6b6b1 1.69M/mo same day (family ~9.6M). Forward falsifier: window empty => auto-demote.
Monthly custody distribution, ~9.5M EIGEN observed last cycle. Backtest: eth wallets 0x3De6b6b1/0x34BcF805 outbound transfers, monthly on the 30th (28th/29th short months) since 2025-10-30.

tokens.note: Custody-held (BitGo WalletSimple x21, 484M family) — behavioural: the announcement described the schedule, custody enforces nothing. TWO metronomes watched (0x34BcF805 ~7.82M/mo + 0x3De6b6b1 ~1.69M/mo, family ~9.5M): every wallet must emit AND the family total must land within 25%, because a message claiming the family figure while checking one wallet could not see the other stopping. Largest wallet (176.7M) mostly dormant = later tranches.
